narr: Widespread showers and thunderstorms brought heavy rain to eastern Pennsylvania on the afternoon and early evening of July 9. Rainfall totals were as high as 4 to around 6 inches.
ev: Widespread roadway flooding and road closures occurred in Muhlenberg Township. PA Route 12 was impassable and closed between PA Route 61 and North Fifth Street. US Route 222 was under water at the PA Route 61 underpass. A house collapsed on Mount Laurel Road along Laurel Run due to basement flooding and the eventual failure of the foundation. The residents needed to be rescued as the house was surrounded by flood waters.
Moderate flooding occurred on the Manatawny Creek around Spangsville in Oley Township.
A vehicle became trapped in flood waters on Union Street at Cedar Creek in Allentown.
A vehicle became trapped in flood waters at the intersection of Swinehart Road and Jackson Road in Douglass Township, necessitating a water rescue.
Flood waters from Pine Creek reached some buildings in Uwchlan Township.
Moderate flooding occurred along the East Branch of the Brandywine Creek between West Bradford Township and East Bradford Township.
Horsham Road was closed between Dresher Road and PA Route 611 in Horsham due to flooding.
A vehicle was stranded in flood waters on Dreshertown Road at Nicole Drive in Upper Dublin Township, necessitating a water rescue.
A vehicle became trapped in flood waters in Upper Moreland Township, necessitating a water rescue.
A vehicle became trapped in flood waters on PA Route 10 at Poplar Road in Honey Brook Township, necessitating a water rescue.

Two vehicles were trapped in flood waters at the intersection of Balligomingo Road and Portland Road in Upper Merion Township. An access ramp from Interstate 476 onto the Schuylkill Expressway in West Conshohocken became impassable due to flooding.
Several vehicles became trapped in flood waters in Radnor Township. Gulph Creek was out of it banks and flooding adjacent properties along Plant Avenue in Radnor Township.
Flood waters made the Schuylkill Expressway impassable around Weadley Road in Upper Merion Township.
Minor flooding occurred along Crum Creek between Edgmont Township and Newtown Township.
Widespread roadway flooding and road closures occurred in Quakertown. Numerous vehicles were trapped in flood waters making some water rescues necessary.
Kutztown Road was impassable due to flood waters between Schwenkenfelder Road and Peevy Road in Upper Hanover Township.
Morgan Creek overflowed its banks in Trumbauersville, flooding a section of Allentown Road near Yankee Road.
Minor flooding occurred along the Perkiomen Creek in Upper Hanover Township.
Some residents were evacuated from their homes in Durham Township due to rising flood waters.
Centre Street was closed at Palmer Street in Easton due to flooding.

Widespread roadway flooding and road closures occurred in Maidencreek Township. US Route 222 became impassable. A shed was displaced by the flood waters in a community park. Willow Creek overflowed onto Dries Road trapping one vehicle.
Widespread roadway flooding with some roads becoming impassable in Oley Township. The Reider Road bridge over Furnace Creek was damaged causing the road to buckle.

Widespread roadway flooding and road closures occurred in Bern Township. Fairview Drive was closed as a nearby creek overflowed onto the road. A truck driver was rescued from his vehicle near the Berks County Prison.
Widespread roadway flooding and road closures in Fleetwood. Willow Creek overflowed its banks and damaged some roads in Fleetwood Park.
Shillington Road was closed at Iroquois Avenue in Spring Township due to flooding.
